# Chapter 1: Getting Started

How should I study a Bible chapter? Begin by reading it several times before
reaching for any commentary, letting the text set the agenda.

# Inductive Study

Observation, interpretation, and application are the three movements of
inductive study. Observation asks what the text says.

<!-- page: 2 -->

Interpretation asks what it means; application asks what it demands. This
paragraph continues onto the second page of the guide.

# Index

Genesis, 1; Exodus, 2; Romans, 3; Covenant, 5.
